inventory_metadata.host_silicon: Intel Core i5-12450H / i5-13420H CPU + Intel UHD Graphics + 16GB RAM
inventory_metadata.audit_standard: Strict Scientific Falsification & Anti-Chaos Implementation Control

subsystems.name: hyper_x/verification
subsystems.purpose: Fail-closed multi-modal verification and cryptographic certification foundation

subsystems.name: hyper_x/information_boundary
subsystems.purpose: Minimal observable boundary, reverse reachability, and backward slicing
subsystems.known_weaknesses: Complex non-linear operator reachability requires symbolic differentiation

subsystems.name: hyper_x/execution_fabric
subsystems.purpose: Heterogeneous dynamic dispatch across Intel CPU cores and Intel UHD execution units
subsystems.known_weaknesses: PCIe/Ring bus transfer latency must be amortized over large batch sizes

subsystems.name: hyper_x/temporal_escape
subsystems.purpose: Temporal delta computing, motion vector backward reprojection, and variance clamping
subsystems.known_weaknesses: Disoccluded spatial regions require fallback localized re-render

subsystems.name: hyper_x/speculative
subsystems.purpose: Lossless speculative draft generation with parallel target verification
subsystems.known_weaknesses: Low acceptance rate (<40%) can lead to speculative draft overhead

subsystems.name: hyper_x/cache
subsystems.purpose: Cryptographically keyed exact memoization separating lookup time from avoided compute
subsystems.known_weaknesses: Memory capacity bounded by LRU cache limits

subsystems.name: hyper_x/wormhole_compiler
subsystems.purpose: Algorithmic genome mutation, equality saturation, and transformation engine
subsystems.known_weaknesses: E-graph saturation budget limits maximum rewrite exploration depth

subsystems.name: hyper_x/counterexample_registry
subsystems.purpose: Persistent storage of failed transformations and disproven hypotheses

subsystems.name: hyper_x/fallback
subsystems.purpose: 3-tier deterministic degradation to guaranteed canonical references

subsystems.name: benchmarks
subsystems.purpose: Canonical physical hardware test harnesses (GEMM, Graphics, LLM, Science)
